name: container-scroll-animation
title: Container Scroll Animation
description: A headline sits above a large framed product screen that starts tilted back in 3D. Scrolling straightens the screen to flat and grows it slightly while the headline drifts up, showing off the app.
use: A SaaS landing hero should show off a product screen with a dramatic scroll-driven lift.
avoid: The page must avoid tall scroll sections, or the product screen needs to be light.
a11y: The tilt has no reduced-motion fallback and only switches by viewport width; the heading and screen come from the demo. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bold two-line white headline centred above a big dark screen in a thick grey rounded bezel. The screen shows a dashboard with a narrow sidebar, four small metric cards, a grey bar chart with one white bar, and a short list of deals; early on the screen leans back in perspective.
behaves: Scrolling straightens the screen from a 20-degree backward tilt to flat while it scales up a little, and the headline drifts upward. The heavy layered shadow under the screen deepens as it comes forward, holding at the flat state at the end of the section.
customise: titleComponent sets the heading and children fill the framed screen. The sixty-rem section height, the tilt, the scale and the grey bezel colours are fixed in the source.
weight: light: Two scroll transforms driving one framed card and its header.
demo: Headline Every number your team needs over a Northwind dashboard with Revenue $48,210 and deals like Acme Corp.
issues: The dashboard is very dark on the black stage, so its panels and chart barely separate.
The grey bezel gives little contrast against the background until the screen is flat.
polishWhy: A smooth, confident scroll reveal of a clean dashboard; the dark-on-dark demo holds it back.
